description: Use this when the user asks if a website is hacked, infected or safe, or wants a security check of a site. Arx Site Check: injected malware and SEO spam on the page, blocklists, outdated WordPress and plugins, exposed files (.git, .env, backups), security headers and firewall. Read-only remote scan powered by Lanetti Tools.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com/path. Localhost, private and metadata addresses are rejected.

name: oma_scan_website_security
title: Scan website security (Arx Site Check)
